Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Gave an incorrect domain and URL for a source (“infairfaxcounty.gov” and https://www.infairfaxcounty.gov/tysons-galleria-in-mclean-virginia instead of infairfaxcounty.com), which led the WebSurfer to a fruitless search and misdirected sourcing. The Planner also treated infairfaxcounty.com as an official Fairfax County source, misclassifying its authority.
